variables.name: timeNowString
variables.description: Properly ISO formatted string for posting event to JDS

variables.name: orgID
variables.description: Org ID comes from the original flow

variables.name: timeEarlierInt
variables.description: Integer variable, used for defining the start of lookback period for Search API calls

variables.name: timeNowInt
variables.description: End of the lookback period for Search API

variables.name: errorType
variables.description: Details the error as to why the flow didnt work

variables.name: agentId
variables.description: ID of the agent that answered the call.

variables.name: origin
variables.description: Origin call leg from Search query

variables.name: destination
variables.description: Destination call leg from Search query

variables.name: agentName
variables.description: Last agent name sourced from Search API for CJDS write

variables.name: ciUserId
variables.description: Common Identity UserId for the agent

variables.name: SummariesDebug
variables.description: placeholder to check if there's a summary present

properties.description:
Set up org-specific variables. Org ID and JDS Workspace should be your org-specific details. timeEarlierInt defines the start of a 15-minute lookback period for the search API (Epoch time in milliseconds). timeNowInt complements this with the current time. timeNowString defines the JDS expected time format.  
PostCallSummaryID is set using the correct three sets of strings (org ID - Task ID - Agent ID)
properties.name: Setup_vars
